//: This repo's own base (./tsconfig.base.json, named to the typescript pack as `tsconfigBase`) and two additions, nothing subtracted. `module` and `moduleResolution` stay the base's NodeNext: this package is `type: module` and NodeNext describes it exactly.
`allowImportingTsExtensions` because every import here names its `.ts` file — esbuild bundles them and `noEmit` (also from the base) is what makes that legal.
`types` narrows the ambient set to node's; without it every @types package installed anywhere in the tree becomes globally visible.

`include` is a glob and not `.` because TypeScript reads a bare `.` as a FILE when the project directory's name carries a dot — and a worktree is named `repo.branch` by convention, so `.` there found no inputs at all and the build died at type emit. Only `.ts` files are inputs here, so the glob is exact.

`__fixtures__` is EXCLUDED and that is the point of it: it holds configs that are deliberately wrong, one per grammar-misuse class, and `grammar.test.ts` compiles them under their own project and asserts the compiler refused. Typechecking them here would mean this project can never be green.
